newsitem.title: UK: Copper holds above $2,200 in late LME.
newsitem.headline: Copper holds above $2,200 in late LME.

text.p: Copper prices remained comfortably above the $2,200 level during late Wednesday evening LME trading, while aluminium stayed close to earlier 2-1/2 month peaks, traders said.
Business was fairly slow during the evening with the markets largely consolidating earlier fund-related buying that lifted copper to five-month highs and zinc to 6-1/2 month peaks.
Some said that copper and aluminium in particular need to catch breath, as technical indicators are giving off overbought signals.
This may keep copper below $2,250 and aluminium under $1,520 in the short-term, they said.
Copper was indicated at $2,208/13 a tonne just after 1900 gmt, while aluminium was quoted at $1,511/16 a tonne.
